entries.title: macOS, Libraries & Team Builder Update
changes: This update adds macOS support, expands the Figure and Plate Libraries, improves Team Building and Plate management, introduces new sorting and filtering options, and fixes several Pokémon Abilities and gameplay interactions.
🍎 MACOS SUPPORT
Added macOS support for Pokémon Duels Remake.
macOS and Windows players can play against each other through the same multiplayer system.
Added macOS support for the in-game cumulative PCK update system.
Windows and macOS players can now download and use the same PCK updates from GitHub.
Windows and macOS full game builds remain separate, while regular game updates can use one shared cumulative patch.
📚 LIBRARIES
Moved the Figure Library and Plate Library into a new Library section accessible directly from the Main Menu.
Redesigned the Plate Library with a visual Plate grid and a dedicated Plate preview panel.
Improved Plate card sizing, scrolling, spacing and preview positioning.
Added searching, filtering and sorting to the Plate Library.
Plate searches now include Plate descriptions and effects, allowing players to search for specific effects such as Mega Evolution.
Added Plate filters for Cost, Type and Rarity.
Added Plate sorting by Name, Plate ID, Cost, Rarity and Type.
Added Pokémon sorting options including Name, Pokédex Number, Rarity, Type, MP, Damage and move properties.
Improved the Figure Library layout and Pokémon information previews.
👥 TEAM BUILDER
Redesigned Plate selection in the Team Builder using visual Plate cards and full Plate previews.
Added Plate searching, filtering and sorting directly inside the Team Builder.
Saving a team now automatically returns to the Saved Teams screen.
Removed numbering from selected Pokémon team slots.
Empty team slots can now be selected before adding a Pokémon, allowing players to choose the exact slot where a Pokémon will be placed.
Improved Pokémon name and rarity presentation throughout the Team Builder.
Added dedicated C, UC, R, EX and UX rarity logos beside Pokémon names.
Improved rarity logo sizing and positioning across Pokémon lists, selected teams and Pokémon information cards.
📏 TEAM LIMIT RULES
Updated the 3-Pokémon team limit to support Pokémon whose Abilities explicitly allow additional copies.
Added copy-limit exceptions for Form Herd, Team Fight, Cross Wind, Reflective Laser and Shelter.
Evolution-family members continue to share the normal 3-copy limit unless an applicable Ability overrides it.
🃏 PLATES
Plate titles now use colors matching their Plate category icons.
Updated Crypt Energy to EX rarity.
Changed Crypt Energy to use the Pokémon Plate category and Pokémon Plate icon.
Improved Plate rarity and category presentation throughout the game.
✨ ABILITIES & MOVE EFFECTS
Fixed Snowy Transformation target selection.
When Alolan Vulpix or Alolan Ninetales is on the field, Snowy Transformation can switch with any frozen Pokémon.
When Alolan Vulpix or Alolan Ninetales is on the bench, Snowy Transformation can switch only with one of its owner's frozen Pokémon.
Fixed Crimson Alloy and Crush of Doom★ timing so Cracked markers created during a battle are applied only after that battle finishes.
Improved Rotom's Revert selection with visual Rotom figure choices.
Rotom forms can now be hovered during Revert to view their full Pokémon information card.
Improved Rotom Revert loading performance.
Fixed after-battle Ability and Evolution sequencing, including Emergent Evolution interactions.
🏷️ TAGGING & TURN RULES
Tagging is now available only when it would actually remove a valid condition or effect.
Pokémon can no longer be tagged unnecessarily when they have nothing that Tagging can remove.
Players can no longer voluntarily end their turn while one of their Pokémon still has a legal MP move available.
⚔️ BATTLE & HUD
Status condition icons during wheel battles now cover the center of the battle wheel for improved visibility.
Improved AI emergency Goal defense behavior against immediate Goal threats.
Activatable Ability buttons now appear above the turn indicator in the bottom-right battle HUD.
Long Ability names now expand horizontally instead of vertically.
Added access to Settings during normal battlefield play.
The Settings button automatically hides during wheel battles and while Pokémon information cards are being viewed.
Improved Settings button presentation and visibility.
New players now start with the default audio volume set to 10%.
Existing players keep their previously saved audio settings.
📜 PATCH NOTES
View previous Patch Notes and follow development on Discord: https://discord.com/invite/dzVEA5jxgD
